distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Chongqing, Jiangxi, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence, with records from Ilan (Fu Shan) and Nantou (Hui Son and Neimoupu).

host_note: No host is promoted from the Smith record. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated field; broad polyphagy remains contextual.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea minutus (Blandford, 1894).

taxonomic_history.name: Euwallacea minutus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) treats the species as Planiculus minutus in a 2010 new combination; Smith et al. (2020) treats the current combination Euwallacea minutus. Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Euwallacea minutus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_2708.
